## Highlights

Zova 1.0.0-rc.3 introduces experimental browser SQL/KV and improves native
package portability while retaining storage format 11.

This is a prerelease. Validate applications and migrations before Zova 1.0.0;
browser APIs are experimental and outside the candidate stable native contract.

## What's changed

- Added `zova-wasm`: the real Zova core and SQLite in a dedicated browser worker,
  supporting SQL and binary KV in memory and in named OPFS databases.
- Added exclusive persistent-database ownership, explicit busy errors, and
  installed-package browser coverage for persistence, rollback and storage faults.
- Split Rust native source distribution into target-specific generated-C
  companion crates. Supported consumers need a C compiler, not Zig or build-time
  source downloads. Release gates verify the packaged artifacts.
- Prepared native and Python Rust snapshots before release version validation.
- Enabled WASM publication for both stable and prerelease releases, with matching
  artifact-integrity checks and retry-safe dist-tag handling.

## Candidate 1.x contract

- Package and full ABI identity are `1.0.0-rc.3`; numeric ABI remains `1.0.0`.
- Advanced graph APIs remain C ABI/raw `zova-sys` surfaces.
- Experimental extension authoring and browser API stability remain outside the
  stable native contract. Browser support does not imply full native parity.

## Storage compatibility

- Format remains 11. rc.1 and rc.2 format-11 databases need no migration.
- Formats 9 and 10 retain explicit copy-forward migration; the source is unchanged.
- Opening does not silently migrate. Older formats and downgrades are unsupported.

## Prerelease installation

- GitHub marks this release as a prerelease.
- npm publishes `zova-js`, its native companions, and `zova-wasm` under `next`.
- Python uses `1.0.0rc3`, with CPython 3.13 stable-ABI wheels tested on 3.13 and
  3.14. No Python source distribution is published.
- Cargo and Go use `1.0.0-rc.3`.

## Known boundaries

WASM currently supports SQL/KV, not the complete native API. Export/import,
shared multi-tab connections, automatic browser storage migration, and general
bundler compatibility are not promised. Memory database contents disappear on
close or worker termination; OPFS storage remains subject to browser policies.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ata-sesli/zova/compare/v1.0.0-rc.2...v1.0.0-rc.3
